verdict.rationale: New Relic documents a single platform that brings logs together with the rest of your telemetry and infrastructure data. Its APM agents add metadata to logs to give 'logs in context' across the platform, and log management surfaces related events, errors and traces, so the logs-centric pivot is directly documented. However, the evidence does not explicitly show trace-to-metric or metric-to-trace pivoting with shared context, and distributed tracing collection is only mentioned in passing. missing for 10: explicit documentation of metrics/traces/logs correlation in all directions (e.g. trace-to-metric drill-down), dedicated distributed-tracing collection docs, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-signal pivoting.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can collect metrics, logs, and traces in one platform and pivot between them with shared context
